FA-1.alignmentRationale: The question directly addresses bias identification and mitigation, which is a core requirement in the EU AI Act regarding high-risk AI systems.
FA-1.framework_citations: Art. 10(2)(f): "Data sets shall be subject to examination in view of possible biases that are likely to affect health and safety of persons, have a negative impact on fundamental rights or lead to discrimination" and Art. 10(2)(g): "appropriate measures to detect, prevent and mitigate possible biases"

FA-2.alignmentRationale: The question focuses on ensuring training data represents all relevant demographics, which directly corresponds to the EU AI Act's requirements on data quality.
FA-2.framework_citations: Art. 10(3): "Data sets shall be relevant, sufficiently representative, and to the best extent possible free of errors and complete in view of the intended purpose... They shall have the appropriate statistical properties, including, where applicable, as regards the persons or groups of persons in relation to whom the high-risk AI system is intended to be used."

FA-3.alignmentRationale: The question addresses evaluation of outputs for disparities across user groups, which aligns with the risk management and post-market monitoring requirements.
FA-3.framework_citations: Art. 9(2)(b): "the estimation and evaluation of the risks that may emerge when the high-risk AI system is used in accordance with its intended purpose" and Art. 72(2): "The post-market monitoring system shall actively and systematically collect, document and analyse relevant data"

alignedControls.description: Post-market monitoring by providers and post-market monitoring plan for high-risk AI systems

FA-4.alignmentRationale: The question specifically addresses how fairness is measured, which aligns with the risk assessment and monitoring requirements in the EU AI Act.
FA-4.framework_citations: Art. 9(4): "The risk management measures... shall give due consideration to the effects and possible interaction resulting from the combined application of the requirements" and Art. 15(2): "To address the technical aspects of how to measure the appropriate levels of accuracy and robustness"

FA-5.alignmentRationale: The question addresses testing for biases in real-world scenarios, which directly aligns with the Act's requirements on testing and evaluation.
FA-5.framework_citations: Art. 9(6): "High-risk AI systems shall be tested for the purpose of identifying the most appropriate and targeted risk management measures" and Art. 9(8): "The testing of high-risk AI systems shall be performed... against prior defined metrics and probabilistic thresholds"

FA-6.alignmentRationale: The question asks about frameworks/tools for bias assessment and mitigation, which aligns with the technical measures required in the Act.
FA-6.framework_citations: Art. 9(2)(d): "the adoption of appropriate and targeted risk management measures" and Art. 10(2)(g): "appropriate measures to detect, prevent and mitigate possible biases"

FA-7.alignmentRationale: The question focuses on fairness for minority or underserved groups, which aligns with the EU AI Act's non-discrimination and fundamental rights protections.
FA-7.framework_citations: Art. 10(2)(f): "examination in view of possible biases... likely to affect health and safety of persons, have a negative impact on fundamental rights or lead to discrimination" and Art. 10(3): "appropriate statistical properties, including, where applicable, as regards the persons or groups of persons"

FA-8.alignmentRationale: The question addresses whether fairness is embedded in the design process or addressed post-deployment, which aligns with risk management and design requirements.
FA-8.framework_citations: Art. 9(1): "A risk management system shall be established, implemented, documented and maintained in relation to high-risk AI systems" and Art. 9(2): "The risk management system shall be understood as a continuous iterative process planned and run throughout the entire lifecycle of a high-risk AI system"
